content.hero:
Between what we hear
and what we feel.
content.about1: Xinyun Zhang is a media artist working at the intersection of sound, technology, visual media, and spatial experience. Her practice explores the translation between different forms of media and perception, creating situations in which sound, image, movement, and space interact and transform one another.
content.about2: Her works take forms ranging from interactive installations and audiovisual environments to experimental instruments and live performance. Technology often functions as a connective structure within these works, allowing sound, image, physical objects, performers, and audiences to influence one another in real time.
content.activities: Activity notes will be added here.
content.education:
Zhang studied Digital Media Art at the Central Academy of Fine Arts in Beijing, developing a multidisciplinary practice across design, moving image, interaction, and spatial media. During an exchange in Media Art at the Karlsruhe University of Arts and Design (HfG Karlsruhe), her engagement with the Sound program brought sound and experimental electronic practices into increasing focus.
She is currently studying Klang & Realität at the Robert Schumann Hochschule Düsseldorf. She lives in Düsseldorf.

projects.title: Post-Symphonic Poem
projects.description:
An interactive audiovisual installation inspired by Friedrich Nietzsche’s Thus Spoke Zarathustra and Richard Strauss’s tone poem of the same name. The work translates the three transformations of the spirit — camel, lion and child — into navigable spaces of sound and image. Visitors use a MIDI controller to shape sound, particle systems and spatial states.

Role: Concept, sound design, visual design, 3D modelling and system design. Tools: TouchDesigner, Blender, Ableton Live and MIDI controller.

projects.title: Overlap
projects.description:
A collaborative live audiovisual performance by Yunfei Zhang and Xinyun Zhang, presented at MKULTRA Sound at HfG Karlsruhe in 2026. Electronic circuits generate sound and VGA image signals at the same time. Two performers alter voltage and parameters live, creating continuously shifting audiovisual structures.

Role: Co-creator, system integration, visual design and live performance. Tools: CMOS synthesizer, VGA signal processing and projection.

projects.title: Moo(?)
projects.description:
A speculative design project examining genetic modification, emotion and visual identity. Starting from the characteristic patterns of dairy cows, the project imagines emotions being modified, encoded and consumed. Generative processes translate emotional states into visual patterns and a series of fictional products.

Role: Generative design, 3D modelling and product design. Tools: Blender, Python, p5.js, InDesign and 3D printing.

projects.title: Resonante Bühne
projects.description:
An interactive stage installation connecting sound, light and movement in one responsive system. Sensors allow the stage to react in real time to performers and audiences; movement, voices and ambient sound reshape its audiovisual atmosphere. The project treats the stage as an active resonant space rather than a static backdrop.

Role: Concept, interaction design, system design and prototyping. Tools: Arduino, M5Stack and ESP32.
